svg.aria-label: Backbone links, top to bottom. STC modem LAN port to SWAGGER-4331-ISR01 Gi0/0/1 over DHCP, 1 GbE. ISR Gi0/0/0 192.168.50.1 to OPNsense firewall WAN 192.168.50.2 on 192.168.50.0/30, 1 GbE. OPNsense LAN to SWAGGER-CORE-SW01 Gi1/0/1 as a 1 GbE trunk: VLAN 100 is the transit link on 192.168.50.4/30 (OPNsense 192.168.50.5, core 192.168.50.6), and VLAN 30 carries Guest traffic to OPNsense, its gateway. Core Te1/0/1-2 to SWAGGER-ACCESS-SW01 Te1/0/1-2 as port-channel 1, a 2 x 10G LACP trunk carrying all VLANs.
svg.title: Backbone links
